mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cart (user_id, create_user_id, create_program, update_user_id, update_program) VALUES (#{userId}, #{createUserId}, #{createProgram}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateProgram}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cart_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(cart_id)
mapper.select: SELECT ci.item_id AS item_id, i.product_id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, i.attribute1 AS attribute1, i.list_price AS list_price, ci.quantity AS quantity, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity FROM t_cart_item ci JOIN m_item i ON i.item_id = ci.item_id JOIN m_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN t_inventory inv ON inv.item_id = ci.item_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.item_id

SELECT i.item_id AS item_id, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity, COALESCE(ci.quantity, 0) AS current_quantity FROM m_item i LEFT JOIN t_inventory inv ON inv.item_id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN t_cart_item ci ON ci.cart_id = #{cartId} AND ci.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cart_item (cart_id, item_id, quantity, create_user_id, create_program, update_user_id, update_program) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity}, #{createUserId}, #{createProgram}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateProgram}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = VALUES(quantity), update_user_id = VALUES(update_user_id), update_program = VALUES(update_program)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND item_id = #{itemId}
